claim: Since 1.3.0 Rugix Ctrl accepts bundle signatures from any configured certificate root and keeps checking other signatures and roots when one candidate is invalid
Rugix Ctrl config schema: signatures.roots is a required array of root certificates (multiple trust roots)

Rugix Ctrl v1.4.0 source defines a luks2-tpm2 data-partition driver: systemd-cryptenroll seals a random LUKS2 passphrase to the TPM, unsealed each boot with cryptsetup --token-only, described as production-grade; not listed in the CHANGELOG
Rugix upstream integration test (swtpm TPM 2.0, amd64 EFI VM) checks that the TPM-sealed key unlocks the data partition after installing an update and booting the other boot group
Rugix Ctrl has a native systemd-boot boot flow that selects entries via the LoaderEntryDefault/LoaderEntryOneShot EFI variables using bootctl set-oneshot
Rugix upstream tests cover update state transitions for the rauc-grub and mender-uboot compatibility boot flows

On rugix/rugix#121 (2026-08-22) the maintainer stated there is no bundle version and downgrades can be prevented through Runtime and Local component constraints (a min-version component conflicting with older versions); the issue remains open
Rugix component schema supports requires and conflicts capability selectors
thin-edge.io (Apache-2.0 IIoT edge framework, Cumulocity) official docs have a Rugix section for building OTA-capable images; the building-image docs contain only rugix and yocto routes
thin-edge/meta-tedge ships meta-tedge-rugix, meta-tedge-rauc and meta-tedge-mender layers and a kas project tedge-rugix-tpm2 (Raspberry Pi, scarthgap, rugix-ctrl)
thin-edge/tedge-rugix-image builds thin-edge.io images with Rugix for Raspberry Pi 0-5 (tryboot on Pi 4/5) and Debian 12 EFI amd64/arm64, using Rugix Bakery 0.9
rugix/rugix-example-revpi provides Rugix integration examples for Revolution Pi covering application and full OS updates
rugix/rugix-example-stratopi provides A/B OTA for Strato Pi Max via Pi tryboot and dual-SD failover
Automation World article (2026-08-21) co-authored by Sfera Labs' co-founder and Silitics' CEO presents Rugix with Strato Pi Max for industrial OTA recovery; vendor-authored
